original_test_intent: Establish that the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe path supports five hundred reliable Gen1-to-Gen3 transitions at the intended width, including any required intermediate training, with no new link or platform errors.
original_method: Confirm Gen3 capability across every component in the selected path and define Speed Change 13 behavior; baseline topology/link/errors; execute five hundred individually numbered Gen1-to-Gen3 transactions; capture requested, intermediate LTSSM/generation, and settled Gen3 width plus error deltas; stop immediately on a capability, settling, width, endpoint, or health failure and recover through the approved console path.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE certifies Gen3 support and the proprietary Speed Change 13 recipe; an operator protects the dedicated SUT and performs out-of-band recovery if the endpoint or host becomes unavailable.

Exact PCIe path/lane map and required width
Gen1 entry, Gen3 request, intermediate Gen2/LTSSM, settle timeout, and transient rules
Five-hundred-count policy, acceptable error deltas, aborts, final state, and recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT with stable power/cooling and console path

Do not continue or automatically replay after the first anomaly

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2102 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00024-V002: approve the pinned LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 13 recipe, end-to-end Gen3 capability and root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint path, Gen1 setup and Gen3 request, expected width/intermediate LTSSM or Gen2 trajectory/settle timeout, 500-count and error-delta rules, first-fault aborts, final state, and recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the distinct Gen3 stress coverage and prevents lower-generation or end-state evidence from hiding path-capability, intermediate-training, width, or iteration failures.
independent_technical_reasoning: Reaching Gen3 is an end-to-end channel property: any root port, retimer, switch, endpoint, firmware, or physical segment can constrain the result or force downtraining. The trajectory also matters because the platform may pass through Gen2 or Recovery while equalization completes; an undefined intermediate state can be either expected behavior or the first symptom of instability. Capturing only the final state discards that distinction. Each transaction must therefore bind the request to its LTSSM path, settled width/generation, and new-error delta before another transition changes the evidence.
